boundary: Compares trainable original MINDS public-code baseline against KT2SequenceJointModel on the same FOREST-source datasets. Handcrafted/heuristic baselines are excluded from the improvement verdict. preflight evidence proves the pipeline and a directional comparison only; full_validation_passed=true is required before claiming final KT2 improvement over MINDS.

comparison_model_filter.rule: Only trainable MINDS and KT2SequenceJointModel rows can enter pair verdicts and metric deltas.

rows.methodology: Original MINDS public-code adapter: sequential hypergraphs, adversarial learning, macro/micro diffusion prediction.

training_protocol.rollout: autoregressive multi-step rollout aggregated into future-window Top-K
training_protocol.trend_decoder: CasFT-style Euler latent dynamics with positive cumulative increments
